lsa_uid0_multiple.title: More than one UID 0 account was observed
lsa_uid0_multiple.recommendation: Review whether every UID 0 account is required and separately attributable.
lsa_uid0_multiple.limit: Account names and authentication activity were not collected.

lsa_ssh_root_login.recommendation: Review an attributable administrator account, working privilege elevation and recovery access before considering disabling direct root SSH login.
lsa_ssh_root_login.title: SSH configuration permits direct root login in {context_label}
lsa_ssh_root_login.limit: {context_limit} This does not prove that root login was used or externally reachable.

lsa_ssh_password_auth.recommendation: Review attributable administrator access, working privilege elevation and key-based recovery before considering disabling password authentication.
lsa_ssh_password_auth.title: SSH password authentication is enabled in {context_label}
lsa_ssh_password_auth.limit: {context_limit} This does not prove weak passwords, exposure, or successful authentication.

lsa_host_firewall_inactive.title: Queried host-firewall controls reported inactive
lsa_host_firewall_inactive.recommendation: Confirm the intended network-control boundary and enable a host firewall where required.
lsa_host_firewall_inactive.limit: The collector queried supported local providers; upstream controls and actual reachability were not tested.

lsa_firewall_default_allow.title: Host firewall default inbound policy allows traffic
lsa_firewall_default_allow.recommendation: Confirm that every inbound service is intended and change the default policy only with a recovery path.
lsa_firewall_default_allow.limit: Rule order, upstream controls and external reachability were not tested.

lsa_unexpected_listener.title: Listening endpoints fell outside the declared listener baseline
lsa_unexpected_listener.recommendation: Identify the owning service and confirm each endpoint before changing or stopping it.
lsa_unexpected_listener.limit: The declared listener baseline does not independently establish service intent. Process identifiers and external reachability were not collected.

lsa_expected_listener_missing.title: Expected listening endpoints were not observed
lsa_expected_listener_missing.recommendation: Confirm whether the endpoint in the declared listener baseline is intentionally absent or bound to a different address.
lsa_expected_listener_missing.limit: A point-in-time local socket view does not establish service availability over time.

lsa_authorized_keys_metadata.title: Authorized-key file metadata fell outside the admitted baseline
lsa_authorized_keys_metadata.recommendation: Review ownership and permissions separately before changing SSH access.
lsa_authorized_keys_metadata.limit: Key contents, validity and authentication activity were not collected.

lsa_authorized_keys_metadata_unknown.title: Root authorized-key metadata could not be read
lsa_authorized_keys_metadata_unknown.recommendation: Review root SSH access metadata separately with approved read authority before changing access.
lsa_authorized_keys_metadata_unknown.limit: Unreadable metadata is not evidence of unsafe ownership, permissions, or key content.

lsa_sudoers_dropin_metadata.title: Sudoers drop-in metadata fell outside the admitted baseline
lsa_sudoers_dropin_metadata.recommendation: Review affected metadata and validate syntax before making any privilege change.
lsa_sudoers_dropin_metadata.limit: Sudoers contents and effective direct grants were not assessed.

lsa_security_updates_available.title: Cached package metadata reports available security updates
lsa_security_updates_available.recommendation: Review and schedule the security updates through the host's normal change process.
lsa_security_updates_available.limit: The scan used local cached metadata and did not refresh repositories or install packages.

lsa_reboot_required.title: The host reports a pending reboot
lsa_reboot_required.recommendation: Schedule a controlled reboot with service and recovery checks.
lsa_reboot_required.limit: The marker does not identify the package or guarantee that a reboot resolves every pending update.

lsa_failed_services.title: Failed system services were observed
lsa_failed_services.recommendation: Review each failed unit against the host's intended service inventory.
lsa_failed_services.limit: A failed unit is not by itself evidence of compromise or business impact.

lsa_clock_unsynchronized.title: Host clock reported not synchronized
lsa_clock_unsynchronized.recommendation: Restore approved time synchronization and record the source used.
lsa_clock_unsynchronized.limit: The collector did not compare the clock against an independent time authority.

lsa_critical_file_metadata.title: Critical account or privilege file metadata fell outside the admitted baseline
lsa_critical_file_metadata.recommendation: Review ownership and permissions before changing them; preserve service-specific exceptions.
lsa_critical_file_metadata.limit: File contents and distribution-specific policy were not assessed.

lsa_mandatory_access_control.title: No enabled AppArmor or enforcing SELinux state was established
lsa_mandatory_access_control.recommendation: Confirm the host's intended mandatory-access-control policy and platform support.
lsa_mandatory_access_control.limit: This is a posture observation, not proof that workload isolation is ineffective.

lsa_ssh_password_auth_unknown.recommendation: Resolve the effective configuration within the approved scope.
lsa_ssh_password_auth_unknown.title: SSH password authentication could not be resolved in {context_label}
lsa_ssh_password_auth_unknown.limit: {context_limit} Unknown does not establish enabled or disabled authentication.

lsa_ssh_root_login_unknown.recommendation: Resolve effective SSH configuration in a separately authorized follow-up.
lsa_ssh_root_login_unknown.title: SSH root-login setting could not be resolved in {context_label}
lsa_ssh_root_login_unknown.limit: {context_limit} Unknown is not evidence that root login is enabled.

lsa_host_firewall_unknown.title: Host firewall state could not be established
lsa_host_firewall_unknown.recommendation: Confirm the intended firewall provider and collect its state with suitable read authority.
lsa_host_firewall_unknown.limit: Unknown is not evidence that no firewall exists.

lsa_updates_available.title: Cached package metadata reports available updates
lsa_updates_available.recommendation: Review the available updates through the host's normal change process.
lsa_updates_available.limit: The scan used local cached metadata and did not refresh repositories or install packages.

lsa_updates_unknown.title: Security-update classification could not be established
lsa_updates_unknown.recommendation: Review security advisory metadata in a separately authorized follow-up; the successful query established a planned update count without classifying security updates.
lsa_updates_unknown.limit: The planned update count uses local cached metadata. Security-update classification and cache freshness were not established.

lsa_updates_unknown__fallback.title: Available update status could not be established
lsa_updates_unknown__fallback.recommendation: Confirm the package manager and refresh policy in a separately authorized maintenance window.
lsa_updates_unknown__fallback.limit: Unknown is not evidence that the host is current or outdated.

critical_file.recommendation: Confirm the file's expected presence and approved read access before changing anything.
critical_file.limit: Unreadable metadata is not evidence of unsafe permissions.

sysctl.recommendation: Review enabling this protection against the host's workload and recovery requirements.
sysctl.limit: A bounded configuration observation; platform exceptions and exploitability require analyst review.
